meta.title: Meta
meta.description: Which Deadlock heroes are strong right now, by rank and patch, with sample sizes and confidence.

header.title: Meta right now
header.description: What’s strong right now, how sure we are, and what’s changing. Start at the top; go deeper only if you need to.

patchNotice.text: The current patch is only {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} old. Expect small samples and treat tiers as early signals.

glance.title: At a glance
glance.description: The six answers most people need. Low-sample heroes are never used here.

tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.description: Tiers come only from the win rate and how certain it is. Pick rate doesn’t change a tier.

table.title: All heroes
table.description: Sort any column. Open “Why?” for the numbers behind a hero.

empty.title: No heroes to show
empty.description: No hero in this role has enough matches in this scope. Try a longer window or a wider rank band.

hiddenLow.text: {count, plural, one {# hero is} other {# heroes are}} hidden with fewer than {threshold} matches.

howTiers.summary: How tiers, trends and confidence work
howTiers.interval: The interval is a 95% Wilson interval: the range the true win rate very likely falls in, given how many matches were played.
howTiers.trendsText: We compare the last 7 days with the 7 days before. A hero is “rising” or “falling” only when the two weeks’ intervals don’t overlap. Otherwise it’s “stable”, even if the number moved a little.
howTiers.confidenceText: Low: under {moderate} matches (no tier, never in summaries). Moderate: up to {high}. High: above that. Pick rate is the share of matches a hero appears in.

filters.share: About {share} of ranked players are in this band (latest ranked match, last 30 days).
filters.regionNote: Not available: the hero statistics source has no region filter.

strongest.title: Strongest picks
strongest.empty: No hero is clearly above 50% in this scope.

table.notEnoughTitle: One of the weeks has fewer than {threshold} matches

panel.title: {hero}: the numbers
panel.sparkline: Daily win rate from {from} to {to}; dashed line is 50%.
panel.disclaimer: These are observed numbers from match data, not explanations of cause. Match data can’t tell us why a hero performs this way.

certainty.low: Only {matches} matches: too few to place in a tier.

why.popularity: Picked in {pickRate} of matches, {rank, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} most picked of {count} heroes.

trend.weeks: Last 7 days {current} ({currentMatches} matches) vs the 7 days before {previous} ({previousMatches}): {delta}. {verdict}

verdict.tooFew: One of the weeks has too few matches to call a trend.
verdict.stable: The two weeks’ intervals overlap, so this is treated as stable.
verdict.rising: The two weeks’ intervals do not overlap, so this counts as rising.
verdict.falling: The two weeks’ intervals do not overlap, so this counts as falling.

trend.missing: No matches in {missing, select, previous {the 7 days before} other {the last 7 days}} for this scope, so no trend can be computed.

why.role: {role} heroes together won {winRate} in this scope; {hero} is {delta} from that.
why.perMatch: Average K/D/A {kills} / {deaths} / {assists}. Average final souls {souls} ({sign, select, plus {+} other {−}}{diff} vs the all-hero average).

pulse.mostPicked: {hero} appeared in {pickRate} of matches (pick rate = its matches ÷ total matches ÷ 12 slots).
pulse.mover: Last 7 days vs the 7 before, and the two weeks’ intervals don’t overlap.
